वैताली

VAITĀLĪ . A warrior of subrahmaṇya. (M.B. śalya Parva, Chapter 45, Stanza 67).

वैतण्ड

VAITAṆḌA . Son of āpa, one of the eight Vasus. āpa had four sons named, vaitaṇḍa, śrama, śānta and dhvani. (viṣṇu purāṇa, aṁśa 1, Chapter 15).

वैतरणी १

VAITARAṆĪ I . A hell. (See under kāla, the Section naraka).

वैतरणी २

VAITARAṆĪ II . The name of river Ganges when it flows through the world of the Manes. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 169, Stanza 22).

वैतरणी ३

VAITARAṆĪ III . A river. The prominence of this river is given below:
(i) This river stays in the court of varuṇa and glorifies him. (mahābhārata, Sabhā Parva, Chapter 9, Stanza 20).
(ii) This river gives remission of sins. There is a spot called Virajatīrtha, in this river. He who bathes in this holy place would shine like the moon. (M.B. Vana Parva, Chapter 85, Stanza 6).
